title: Find the first k where a yes/no question turns true
invariant: k = hi is always enough and k = lo - 1 never is, so the first enough k is between lo and hi.

frames.explanation: A staircase with k steps uses 1 + 2 + ... + k = k(k+1)/2 blocks. Find the smallest k that uses at least 11 blocks. The answer is between lo = 1 and hi = 11 (k = 11 always has enough).

scene.description: First true normal: start, lo 1, hi 11, mid -, blocks -.

labels.text: is k(k+1)/2 ≥ 11?  no … no | yes … yes
the answer is always inside lo..hi

frames.explanation: k = 6 uses 21 blocks, which is enough. Every bigger k is enough too, so the answer is 6 or smaller: hi = 6.

scene.description: First true normal: yes, lo 1, hi 6, mid 6, blocks 21.
